content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PDINC-23456
incident-bot: Severity: P1 — AZ14 (ap-south-2) - Dedicated pool 'dedicated-aps2' high 5xx (~23% at peak). autoscaler attempts failing. root_ts=2159876543
Priya: acked — I'm oncall, grabbing it. @here please avoid duplicate pages while we triage :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: PDINC-23456 acknowledged by Priya
Jordan: Priya — I'm 2nd oncall, standing by. can take lead if you want to handoff in ~10m
Priya: handing to Jordan. tl;dr: autoscaler stuck adding nodes, many pods Pending, wide 502/503 across models. Immediate impact: two Dedicated tenants and ~3% of hosted routes.
Miguel: infra shows control-plane API latency spike in az14 + node provisioning errors. possible NIC throttling on the hypervisor side. recommending partial traffic diversion to ap-south-1 now.
Priya: initiating safe divert for affected dedicated pool — starting 30% shift, will ramp as we confirm stability.
OpsRunbookBot: Runbook: AZ failover & divert -> https://console.redwood/runbooks/az-failover (steps: divert, enable fallback, scale pools, contact provider)
Priya: Commands I'm running:
```
redwood infra divert --from az=ap-south-2 --to az=ap-south-1 --selector=pool=dedicated-aps2 --grace=30s
redwood infra scale --pool=dedicated-aps2 --min=5 --max=20 --force
```
Jordan: watch KV cache rehydration impact — enabling model-variant fallback to reduce memory footprint and speed responses: recommend redwood-lite-quant for affected routes.
Priya: enabled fallback on tenant routes: `set-route-fallback --routes=tenant:A,tenant:B --model=redwood-lite-quant --timeout=1s`
Sam: support triage update: opening tickets for affected customers. Current: 2 enterprise tenants showing ~10% error rates in dashboards; several smaller hosted routes noisy. Sending advisory now.
Miguel: opened cloud support case #CLOUD-98765 for NIC error 409 during instance provisioning in AZ14. attaching node logs.
Priya: PagerDuty: please escalate to infra-eng and networking on provider side. @Miguel pinged provider.
Jordan: quick mitigation applied: disabled continuous-batching for dedicated-aps2 to reduce contention and memory pressure; divert at 30% done, observing lower error surface.
Priya: logs snippet for visibility:
```
[ap-south-2] 5xx spike: 2026-03-15T02:18:12Z model=redwood-mult@v12 latency=120ms err=502 count=143
kubectl describe pod/predictor-abc -n prod
Events:
  Warning  FailedScheduling 10s (x4)  default-scheduler  0/10 nodes available: Insufficient resources.
```
Priya: after divert + fallback: error rate dropped to ~5% overall. still above SLO but improving.
Sam: drafting status page + customer email: "We're experiencing elevated 5xx errors in ap-south-2 AZ14 affecting Dedicated customers. We're diverting traffic and enabling fallback models. Mitigations in progress; no data loss. ETA to recovery 45-60 minutes."
Miguel: cloud provider response: "Throttling discovered on NICs due to backend maintenance; working on removal. ETA 2h." pushing for expedited remediation.
Jordan: if provider ETA >90m plan B = migrate dedicated pool to a fresh subnet in ap-south-2 or shift more capacity to ap-south-1. I'll prepare migration steps.
Priya: PDINC-23456 will remain open. adding postmortem owner: @Jordan. please log timestamps for every action.
Jordan: I'll collect autoscaler logs, nodeprovision traces, PD timeline, and runbook timings for the postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident PDINC-23456 updated: status=investigating, severity=P1, assigned=Jordan
Sam: support update sent to tenant contacts + status page updated (summary + note that we're monitoring).
Priya: handing back lead to Jordan. I'll stay on standby for escalations. thanks all :thumbsup:
Jordan: last check: error rate steady ~3.2%, latency slightly elevated but stable. continuing to monitor. will keep PD updates every 15m until resolved.
incident-bot: PDINC-23456 — last automated update pushed to status page.
